pick.headline: Stroessner overthrown in Paraguay
pick.summary: On 3 February 1989 General Andres Rodriguez overthrew Paraguay's dictator Alfredo Stroessner in an overnight coup, ending 34 years of rule.
pick.significance: Stroessner had been one of the Cold War's longest-ruling anti-communist dictators in the hemisphere. Paraguay began a slow transition to elected government.
